title: (Not reproducible) Godot crashed on folder creation
body:
### Tested versions

Not reproducible.  Happened on Godot Engine v4.7.stable.arch_linux

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 23 May 2026 14:21:20 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CML GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (8 threads) - 31.19 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I created a folder from editor. Godot crushed. Disk space is not an issue. Standard libraries not modified. Issue is not reproducible. Might be something local, no idea what, though. Still decided to post just FYI, fully ready for the isue to be cloased without an answer. Attaching console error dump below:
